text: Inject royal jelly into a willing subject using a specialized injector organ. If the gene carrier's royal jelly is currently regenerating, the injection will not be possible. Injection causes a tiny wound, but when injected, the royal jelly grants the target an immunity boost and a mood boost.
Fly to a distant location that you can or cannot see using a set of gigantic locust wings. Allows the gene carrier to jump over the walls, provided the area they are jumping to is not roofed.
Insector charges towards the target, dealing significant damage to anything on the path. Will destroy any sort of defenses with ease.

Carriers of this gene form a synaptic swarm, allowing their minds to link and accelerate learning when together. Like a hive of insects, their collective intelligence and speed of knowledge absorption increase with each additional member.

Carriers of this gene develop a specialized injector mouth, enabling them to administer royal jelly to others. This injection provides the recipient with an immunity boost and improved mood, though it leaves a tiny wound and can only be performed every six hours.
Carriers of this gene develop pyro-resistant chitin, drastically reducing their flammability and flame damage taken. They remain composed in fiery situations, never succumbing to panic when on fire.

Carriers of this gene possess flame glands, granting them the ability to spew combustible fluid from their mouths. This fluid ignites on contact, setting targets or surfaces ablaze, thanks to a special gland and sac that produce and store the fiery substance.
Carriers of this gene develop locust wings, granting them the special ability to perform a locust leap. This allows them to fly short distances, emulating the powerful and agile leaps of a locust.

Carriers of this gene possess an insect rostrum, a large, sharp beak-like structure akin to that of bees. This adaptation quadruples their eating speed and grants them a powerful melee bite attack, dealing significant stab damage with a quick cooldown.
Carriers of this gene develop acid glands, enabling them to spew acid from their neck, damaging buildings, people and items in a targeted area.
Carriers of this gene possess infrared sensors, allowing them to see clearly in the dark. They suffer no penalties to work speed or movement in darkness, and gain improved accuracy over long range.

Carriers of this gene develop mineral-rich insectskin, forming thick, protective plating on their skin. This natural armor provides significant protection until enough damage is sustained to break it.

Carriers of this gene develop large charger claws, granting them the ability to perform a charge towards a target, dealing significant damage to anything in their path and easily destroying defenses, with the ability to perform this action periodically and over a considerable distance.

Carriers of this gene exhibit a microsized stature, significantly smaller than their counterparts. Their reduced size results in increased stagger duration, lower meat and leather yield, and a smaller yet more efficient hunger requirement.

Carriers of this gene grow to colossal proportions, towering over their peers. Their immense size increases meat and leather yield and hunger needs, while reducing movement speed and melee dodge chance. If equipped with the right enhancements, they can carry the heaviest of weapons and warcasket armaments.

Carriers of this gene develop chemfuel sacks resembling a tail, drastically increasing their susceptibility to flame damage. If engulfed in large enough flames or upon death, they erupt in a fiery explosion. Additionally, they can be "milked" periodically to yield chemfuel.
Carriers of this gene possess a pyrophilic nature, exhibiting a fascination and love for fire. They are drawn to flames and find comfort and joy in their presence.

Carriers of this gene exhibit volatile behavior, drastically increasing their likelihood of initiating social fights and ensuring their mental breaks are always violent when possible. They have a heightened tendency to attempt prison breaks and will use weapons in social confrontations.

Carriers of this gene experience an ecdysone overdrive, creating a constant need for kill satiety. Prolonged periods without melee kills inflict increasing mood penalties, driving them towards violent confrontations to maintain their mental balance.

Carriers of this gene possess an acid burstsack, which triggers an explosive release of corrosive acid when they take a severe hit. This explosion affects everything within a wide radius, causing ongoing damage to those caught in the blast.
Carriers of this gene have solidified grey matter, resulting in a complete inability to learn new skills. They experience accelerated skill loss, which affects them even at lower skill levels.
Carriers of this gene have hardlocked joints, significantly slowing their movements. Their inflexible joints make bending and swift actions extremely difficult.
Carriers of this gene are inherently passive, showing no interest in and being unable to participate in combat. Their nature compels them to avoid violent confrontations entirely.
A large, sharp beak-like structure akin to that of bees that grants a powerful melee bite attack, dealing significant stab damage with a quick cooldown.
The smaller genetic size causes a decrease in hunger rate.
The larger genetic size causes an increase in hunger rate.

Chemfuel sacks make this person very volatile. If set on fire, and the fire is at least 35 in size, they explode in a fire explosion. Upon fire explosion, they will not explode again for 24 hours.\n\nWill produce 30 chemfuel every 10 days.
Upon taking large amounts of damage in a single instance, this person will undergo an acid explosion, covering everything and everyone in 4.9 tile radius in corrosive acid, damaging them over time.
Mineral-rich insectskin forming thick, protective plating. This natural armor provides significant protection until enough damage is sustained to break it.
